test_title: PYST 45: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word 'pursue' from the given sentence.

Dr. Kalam's success in the field of science has inspired young Indians to dream big and chase those dreams with immense hard work.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Chase**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pursue"** means to follow or chase someone or something in order to catch or achieve it. (पीछा करना / साधना)

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to pursue a career in medicine after graduating from college.
 
 
 
• **"Chase"** refers to the act of running after someone or something to catch it, and it is synonymous with "pursue." (पीछा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The police chased the thief through the crowded streets of the city.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of "pursue" in the given context is "Chase."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inspired** (प्रेरित): To fill someone with the urge or ability to do or feel something.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher inspired her students to work hard and achieve their goals.
 
 
 
• **Immense** (विशाल): Extremely large or great, especially in scale or degree.
 
 
• **Example:** The immense popularity of the singer surprised everyone.
 
 
 
• **Success** (सफलता): The accomplishment of an aim or purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** His hard work led to his success in the competitive exam.
 
 

39:Tae1,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.</
